# Fredrick Onyango — Portfolio
> Founder of Synbree. Full-Stack Developer, Backend Engineer & AI/ML Engineer based in Kenya. Building intelligent, scalable products including Kilele Archade (AI EdTech) and Apex (PropTech).

## About
Fredrick Onyango is a Kenya-based software engineer and founder of Synbree, a software engineering and digital innovation company. He specializes in full-stack development, backend engineering, and AI/ML engineering, and builds production systems with React, TypeScript, Python, Java, PostgreSQL, and modern cloud infrastructure. His work spans EdTech (Kilele Archade), PropTech (Apex), HealthTech (MediFlow), and AI/ML experiments.

**Location:** Nairobi, Kenya
**Education:** Degree in Information Technology — Masinde Muliro University of Science and Technology (MMUST), Kakamega, Kenya — https://mmust.ac.ke
**Available for:** Remote work globally, Kenya-based opportunities
**Contact:** onyangofred1005@gmail.com | GitHub: @FredTechDev | LinkedIn: fredrickonyango

## Featured Products

### Kilele Archade — AI-Powered CBC Learning Platform
- **URL:** https://kilelearchade.co.ke
- **Case Study:** https://fredrickonyango.vercel.app/projects/kilele-archade
- **Description:** An AI-powered CBC-focused learning platform providing intelligent learning assistance, revision, assessments, educational resources and personalized learning. Features RAG pipeline with pgvector, curriculum-aware AI tutor, document-based Q&A, quizzes, student/teacher/parent dashboards.
- **Tech Stack:** React, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Cloudinary, Cloudflare AI, RAG, Embeddings, Vector Search
- **Role:** Full-stack developer — architecture, AI pipeline, backend and frontend
- **Status:** Live product

### Apex — Rental Management & Property Automation Platform
- **URL:** https://apexstates.cinecreatives.org
- **Case Study:** https://fredrickonyango.vercel.app/projects/apex
- **Description:** A rental management and property automation platform simplifying property, tenant, payment, reporting, communication and operational workflows. Multi-tenant, role-based access, M-PESA integration, SMS notifications.
- **Tech Stack:** React, TypeScript, Node.js, PostgreSQL, M-PESA Daraja API, SMS integration, Cloud hosting
- **Role:** Founder & lead developer — product concept, architecture and core implementation
- **Status:** In active development

### MediFlow — Clinic Workflow Prototype
- **Case Study:** https://fredrickonyango.vercel.app/projects/mediflow
- **Description:** A clinic workflow prototype for patient records, appointments and queue management — built to explore appointment scheduling and role-scoped clinical data.
- **Tech Stack:** React, Node.js, Express, PostgreSQL
- **Role:** Sole developer
- **Status:** Prototype

### Building a RAG System for an Educational Platform
- **URL:** https://fredrickonyango.vercel.app/blog/building-a-rag-system-for-an-educational-platform

- **Category:** AI Engineering
- **Summary:** How Kilele Archade grounds its AI tutor in actual curriculum documents — ingestion, chunking, pgvector retrieval and provider fallback — instead of letting a model answer from memory.
- **Key Topics:** RAG, pgvector, Embeddings, Chunking, Retrieval, Re-ranking, LLM Provider Fallback, AI in Education

### RAG Strategy Bench
- **Page:** https://fredrickonyango.vercel.app/lab/rag-strategy-bench
- **Repo:** https://github.com/FredTechDev/rag-explorer
- **Description:** Side-by-side evaluation of chunk sizes, embedding models and retrieval strategies on the same document set.
- **Stack:** Python, pgvector, LLM APIs

### AI Provider Fallback Harness
- **Page:** https://fredrickonyango.vercel.app/lab/ai-provider-fallback-harness
- **Repo:** https://github.com/FredTechDev/provider-fallback
- **Description:** Test rig that simulates provider failures to verify transparent failover across LLM backends.
- **Stack:** Node.js, TypeScript, LLM APIs

### Computer Vision Attendance
- **Page:** https://fredrickonyango.vercel.app/lab/computer-vision-attendance
- **Repo:** https://github.com/FredTechDev/vision-attendance
